objections.claim: Turn-1 item ADV-D005-04 was reported accepted but is NOT landed in bytes: the review's standingPosition sentence appears nowhere in the amended entry, while the entry's own Reviewer line claims 'All six items accepted and amended above' — a report ahead of bytes, the exact class D-002's OBS-T3-01 absorbed as standing discipline ('register edits land before messages send') and §7.8 names ('a lane's summary is testimony about an artifact; it is not the artifact').
objections.evidence: Measured on the amended entry (register 1ae0451d…): zero hits, case-normalized, for 'standingPosition', 'implementable as a library', 'shippable', and 'carried forward verbatim' anywhere in the D-005 entry. The review's recommendationToTheCoordinator.standingPosition (3914c9c5…) instructs verbatim: 'this design remains implementable as a library and NOT shippable as production finding identity. That statement survives resolution intact and should keep being carried forward verbatim.' The turn-2 message's itemization listed five fixes, folding my items 04 and 05 into one line ('SF-2/SF-3: the spliced quotation…') that implements only 05. Because the coordinator's instruction makes the entry the executable motion spec ('the application motion executes exactly as specified in the amended entry'), the omission would flow into the freeze application record, dropping the review's only carry-forward instruction.
objections.proposedFix: One amendment: cite the standingPosition sentence verbatim in 'What application would do' beside the does-NOT-close list, with the motion carrying it verbatim into the freeze application record — which also makes the Reviewer line's 'all six amended' sentence true. No other change is needed.
